Pari Fest is a new music and sports festival in Nizhny Novgorod (Russia). The main concept is lightness, movement, space. The author's installations and decor of the festival will enhance the state of lightness and inspiration, which arises as a natural continuation of the architecture and design of the territory, combining with the unique natural landscape.
